howItWorks.title: Simple for patients, powerful for medical teams.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Patients enter the queue in seconds through Afaan Oromoo, Amharic, or English voice prompts or a light mobile form.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Receive real-time position updates and estimated wait time, allowing patients to rest outside crowded hallways.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Clinicians see FIFO queues segmented by clinical urgency (Emergency, Urgent, Normal) with offline resilience.

features.title: Engineered for real Ethiopian healthcare conditions
features.voiceDesc: Spoken Afaan Oromoo and Amharic queue registration designed for low-literacy accessibility and elderly patients.
features.offlineDesc: Local IndexedDB queuing ensures hospitals and patients never stop moving during power cuts or internet outages.
features.ethicalDesc: Strict medical triage priority. No VIP fast-passes or paid queue-skipping. FIFO order within each medical level.
features.analyticsDesc: Live department telemetry helping hospital directors optimize doctor allocation and cut wait times.

forPatientsList: Eliminate 3+ hours sitting in crowded hospital waiting halls
Accessible via voice in native Afaan Oromoo & Amharic
Track queue live from home, coffee shop, or hospital garden
forClinicsList: Drastically reduced waiting room congestion and infection transmission risk
Streamlined clinician triage workflow with instant queue calling
Continuous operation even during telecommunications fiber cuts
Comprehensive operational data for administrative reporting

pitch.dockSubtitle: Jimma University Innovation Pitch Guided Walkthrough

steps.title: 1. Patient Onboarding & Problem
steps.description: Start in the mobile patient app. Highlight the severe Ethiopian hospital waiting challenge and our welcoming trilingual design.

steps.title: 2. Afaan Oromoo Voice Registration
steps.description: Switch the interface to Afaan Oromoo. Demonstrate how a rural or non-literate patient speaks their name and symptom to join without typing.

steps.title: 3. Transparent Live Ticket
steps.description: Show the generated ticket with QR, queue position (#2), and realistic estimated wait time. Explain how families wait safely without hallway crowding.

steps.title: 4. Clinic Staff Console
steps.description: Switch to the Clinic Dashboard. Point out the strictly clinical triage priorities (Emergency, Urgent, Normal) and strict FIFO fairness.

steps.title: 5. Live Queue Calling Action
steps.description: Call the next patient in the OPD queue. Show how the doctor has full control with confirmation safeguards.

steps.title: 6. Real-Time Patient Status Sync
steps.description: Return to the patient screen to show the live status changing to 'Called' with clear room directions and audio alert.

steps.title: 7. Simulate Offline Outage
steps.description: Click 'Simulate Offline' to demonstrate network resilience. Show the clear offline banner and local storage indicator.

steps.title: 8. Offline Queue Registration
steps.description: Create a new patient request while completely disconnected. Notice it is stored locally with 'Pending Sync' safety.

steps.title: 9. Internet Recovery & Auto-Sync
steps.description: Click 'Restore Internet'. Watch IndexedDB automatically synchronize with the clinic server without losing any patient.

steps.title: 10. Analytics & Commercial Potential
steps.description: Show the hospital flow analytics, wait time reduction metrics, and the scalable SaaS/public health partnership model for Jimma and beyond.
